# Calibro

> Calibro is a Dubai studio for bespoke and custom furniture, joinery and contract FF&E. It takes the drawings of architects and interior designers and delivers them as built pieces: detailed in shop drawings, sampled and approved, produced in audited UAE partner workshops, installed and looked after. Calibro Furniture Trading FZE was founded in 2025 on 18+ years of team experience, with a studio in Jebel Ali, Dubai.

- Legal name: Calibro Furniture Trading FZE, Ajman Free Zone, trade licence 53390
- Studio: 47 Street, Jebel Ali Industrial Area, Dubai, United Arab Emirates (by appointment)
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971 58 604 5588
- Email: info@calibro.ae
- Production model: Calibro does not own a factory. Production is placed with audited partner workshops in the UAE; Calibro owns the shop drawings, supervision, quality control, delivery and installation.
- Credits: every project is designed by its architect or interior designer and credited to them; Calibro engineers and produces to their design intent.
- Languages: English (https://calibro.ae) and Arabic (https://calibro.ae/ar)

## Capabilities

- [Bespoke furniture](https://calibro.ae/bespoke-furniture): sofas and seating, tables, beds and headboards, casegoods, made to the designer's drawings
- [Joinery](https://calibro.ae/joinery): wardrobes, wall panelling, vanities, media walls and reception desks
- [Contract FF&E](https://calibro.ae/ffe): complete furniture, fixtures and equipment packages, made and procured under one contract
- [Value engineering](https://calibro.ae/value-engineering): cost changes to what does not show, each approved by the designer
- [Installation and aftercare](https://calibro.ae/delivery-installation): delivery, installation, handover and aftercare across the UAE

## How Calibro works

- [Process](https://calibro.ae/process): six steps from drawings review to installation, each ending in a sign-off
- [Production](https://calibro.ae/production): audited UAE partner workshops and hold-point quality control
- [For interior designers and architects](https://calibro.ae/for/interior-designers): what to send, what comes back, approvals and credit
- [Studio](https://calibro.ae/about): the company, the name (Italian for caliper) and the contact details
- [Contact](https://calibro.ae/contact): send drawings, a BOQ or a sketch
